# Techietribe

Techietribe is a business directory and website platform for finding local businesses, managing listings, creating websites, and accessing account dashboard tools.

- [Directory](https://www.techietribe.ai/directory)
- [Listings](https://www.techietribe.ai/listings)

- [Templates](https://www.techietribe.ai/templates)
- [Contact](https://www.techietribe.ai/contact)
- [App Access and Google Data Use](https://www.techietribe.ai/app-access)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.techietribe.ai/privacy-policy)

- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.techietribe.ai/terms-and-conditions)
